column5: Gap real (vascular cambium/apical meristem only in expert plant-development). Tissue systems, root-tip zones, dead tracheids/vessel elements, bark=all outside vascular cambium, early/late wood all match Campbell ch. 35. Prereqs exist; stage formal-systems >= concrete-operations hard prereqs.

Gap real (Casparian/guard cell/apoplast: no other hits). Apoplast/symplast, suberin Casparian strip, blue-light H+-ATPase driving K+ uptake, radial cellulose micellation, ABA closure, cohesion-tension, small root pressure all match Campbell ch. 36. Wrong: "Every land plant balances this trade-off" - liverworts have no stomata; narrowed to plants with stomata.

Gap real (no plant pressure-flow/Münch hits elsewhere). Münch attribution (German, 1930 Die Stoffbewegungen in der Pflanze; Wikipedia Pressure_flow_hypothesis); proton-sucrose cotransport loading, aphid stylet evidence, girdling, ~1 m/h speed (Campbell; Taiz & Zeiger ~0.3-1.5 m/h) consistent. Prereqs exist, stage ok.

Gap real (gibberellin/tropism only here; auxin only in expert plant-development). Darwin & Darwin 1880 Power of Movement in Plants; Went 1926 agar blocks (bend away from block side); Gibberella fujikuroi foolish-seedling origin of gibberellins; Skoog-Miller auxin:cytokinin root/shoot ratio; statoliths; ethylene ripening/abscission - all correct (Campbell ch. 39). Wrong: "Most tropisms work by moving auxin" - overgeneralized (thigmo-/hydrotropism not shown auxin-driven); narrowed to phototropism and gravitropism.

Gap real (phytochrome/photoperiod only a passing mention in circadian-clock-modeling). Garner & Allard 1920 USDA, Maryland Mammoth flowering in winter greenhouses, J. Agric. Res. 18 (encyclopedia.com photoperiodism; Smithsonian archives); night-break (Hamner & Bonner 1938) 1930s-40s; Pr 660/Pfr 730 nm; last-flash reversibility; FT protein in phloem (Arabidopsis); day-neutral tomato, short-day poinsettia/chrysanthemum, long-day spinach - all correct.

Gap real (no plant mineral-nutrition topic; soil topics are geology). 17 essential elements, 9 macro/8 micro lists, van Helmont willow 5 yr (~74 kg gain), mobile N/Mg vs immobile Ca/Fe, cation exchange via H+, nitrate leaching, mycorrhizae, rhizobia, N-P2O5-K2O labels all match Campbell ch. 37. Wrong (stated 3x): "most of a plant's dry mass is carbon" - carbon is ~45% of dry mass; what holds is that most dry mass comes from CO2 (C plus O). Reworded to "comes from carbon dioxide". Banned word "essential" kept only in the technical term "essential element(s)"; orchestrator may override.

Gap real (PEP carboxylase/Kranz/CAM nowhere else in biology). PEPC uses HCO3- and lacks oxygenase activity; Kranz anatomy; OAA->malate->bundle sheath; pyruvate->PEP costs ATP; CAM named for Crassulaceae, malic acid stored in vacuoles; maize/sugarcane/sorghum C4, pineapple CAM, wheat/rice/oak C3; most species C3 - all correct (Campbell ch. 10). Stage formal-systems = calvin-cycle.

Gap real (sporophyte/gametophyte nowhere else). Sporic meiosis, gametic mitosis, bryophyte gametophyte dominance, dependent moss sporophyte, fern sori and free-living prothallus, charophyte ancestry, pollen as male gametophyte, flagellate sperm needing water in bryophytes/ferns - all correct (Campbell ch. 29-30). Wrong (stated 3x): seed-plant gametophytes "microscopic" - Campbell says "usually microscopic"; the gymnosperm female gametophyte is macroscopic (pine-nut food tissue). Changed to "usually microscopic".

Gap real (double fertilization/embryo sac nowhere else). Nawaschin 1898 (Lilium martagon, Fritillaria; Guignard independently 1899 - Wikipedia Léon Guignard, archive.org biostor 211402); 7-cell/8-nucleate Polygonum-type embryo sac; triploid endosperm; microsporocyte meiosis, tube+generative cell; micropyle; cereal endosperm vs legume cotyledons; ovule->seed, ovary->fruit - all correct (Campbell ch. 38).

Gap real (protostome/deuterostome/Ecdysozoa nowhere else). ~35 phyla, blastopore fates, cnidarian diploblasty and cnidocytes, Lophotrochozoa vs Ecdysozoa membership, insects > all other described animals combined (~1M of ~1.5M), four chordate traits, bilateral echinoderm larvae, coelom grades polyphyletic - all match Campbell ch. 32-34. Prereqs exist; stage ok.

Gap real (Tinbergen/ethology only in psychology attachment-theory, passing). 1973 Nobel to von Frisch, Lorenz, Tinbergen; press release calls them "founders of ... ethology" (nobelprize.org 1973 summary/press release); Tinbergen 1963 four questions; stickleback red-belly sign stimulus; greylag egg-rolling FAP; Lorenz imprinting; Philanthus pinecone spatial learning; waggle dance - all correct (Campbell ch. 51).

Gap real (osmoconformer/nephridia/Malpighian nowhere else). Marine vs freshwater teleost strategies, elasmobranch urea (slightly hyperosmotic), ammonia/urea/uric acid toxicity-water-energy trade-off, who excretes which (incl. land snails), shelled-egg argument, protonephridia/metanephridia/Malpighian tubules - all match Campbell ch. 44. Wrong: land animals conserve water with "kidneys that make concentrated urine" - only mammals and birds make urine hyperosmotic to blood (amphibians, reptiles cannot); changed to "excretory organs that save water".

Gap real (open circulation/tracheae only here; other countercurrent hits are renal). Open (arthropods, most molluscs) vs closed (annelids, cephalopods, vertebrates); tracheae/spiracles; gill countercurrent; 2-, 3-, 4-chambered hearts incl. crocodilian 4 and partly divided reptile ventricle; convergent bird/mammal 4-chamber hearts; avian unidirectional air-sac flow; low-pressure fish systemic flow - all match Campbell ch. 42.

Gap real (no biology water-properties topic; chemistry water-as-universal-solvent covers solvent only; ice/cohesion hits elsewhere are phase-diagram physics). 104.5 deg bond angle, c = 4.18 J/g/C, max density ~4 C, 4-neighbor ice lattice, pH 7 at 25 C, high heat of vaporization, hydrophobic effect in bilayers and folding - all correct (Campbell ch. 3; CRC values). Oil-water misconception uses the Campbell-level enthalpic explanation (entropy not mentioned) - acceptable at this stage. Prereqs exist in chemistry; stage ok.

Gap real (Miller-Urey/RNA world only passing mentions in ribosome/RNA topics; planetary-science habitability topics differ). Earth ~4.5 Ga, stromatolites ~3.5 Ga, Oparin-Haldane 1920s, Miller-Urey 1953 gas mix, Murchison 1969 Australia, Cech & Altman 1989 Chemistry Nobel, RNA peptidyl transferase, clay-catalyzed polymerization, self-dividing vesicles - correct. Wrong: (1) "Experiments have shown that each step can occur under plausible early-Earth conditions" / "each step is chemically possible" overclaims (no full self-replicator under prebiotic conditions); softened to parts of each step reproduced in the lab. (2) "similar reactions occur near volcanoes and deep-sea hydrothermal vents" stated as observed fact; changed to "may have occurred".

Gap real (archaea only passing mentions in microbiology). Woese & Fox 1977; Woese, Kandler & Wheelis 1990; ether-linked isoprenoid lipids with opposite glycerol stereochemistry, monolayer tetraethers; S-layer/pseudopeptidoglycan; Pol II-like RNAP, TBP, histones, Met (not fMet) initiator; no known human pathogen; Methanobrevibacter; bacteriorhodopsin; M. kandleri strain 116 at 122 C (Takai et al. 2008 PNAS, JAMSTEC); Lokiarchaeota from sediment near Loki's Castle (Spang et al. 2015 Nature 521:173), later Asgard; ammonia-oxidizing archaea - correct. Wrong: "Extremophiles were the first archaea studied" - Woese & Fox's 1977 founding work was on methanogens; changed to "Many of the first archaea studied were extremophiles". Stage advanced >= hard prereqs.

Gap real (semicircular/otolith/VOR nowhere else in any domain). Utricle horizontal/saccule vertical, CaCO3 otoconia, orthogonal canals with ampulla and cupula, endolymph inertia and adaptation in steady rotation, after-rotation illusion, push-pull canal pairs, tip links and resting tonic release, CN VIII to vestibular nuclei and cerebellum, short 3-neuron VOR works in dark - all match Bear et al. ch. 11 / Kandel. Stage advanced = auditory-transduction.

Gap real (hybridoma/ELISA only passing in antibody-affinity-and-avidity). Köhler & Milstein 1975 Nature; 1984 Nobel shared with Jerne; HAT = hypoxanthine/aminopterin/thymidine with HGPRT-deficient myeloma; original P3 line secreted its own Ig, later non-secreting lines (Sp2/0) - "later work" phrasing correct; sandwich ELISA, lateral flow with colored particles, flow cytometry CD4 counts; -ximab/-zumab/-umab (pre-2017 INN scheme); rituximab chimeric anti-CD20, trastuzumab humanized anti-HER2, adalimumab human anti-TNF - all correct (Janeway; Kuby). Stage advanced = adaptive-immunity-overview.

Gap real (pair-rule/gap genes only as eve-stripe-2 example in enhancers-silencers-eukaryotic and one line in model-organisms-development). Nüsslein-Volhard & Wieschaus 1980 Nature screen at Heidelberg; 1995 Nobel with E. B. Lewis; bicoid/nanos localization, Nanos represses maternal hunchback translation; gap (hb, Kr, kni, gt), pair-rule (eve, ftz, h) 7 stripes, segment polarity (en, wg, hh) 14 stripes; eve stripe 2 (Bcd, Hb activate; Gt, Kr repress); 3+7 and 4+6 two-stripe enhancers; ftz = "too few segments" - correct (Gilbert ch. 9). Wrong: screen "identified most of these genes" - several named genes were found earlier (engrailed, Krüppel, hairy) or in later maternal screens (bicoid, nanos); changed to "many". Stage expert >= advanced hard prereqs.

Gap real (selective breeding only passing in advanced topics; no domestication topic). Brassica oleracea cultivars (kale, cabbage, broccoli, cauliflower, Brussels sprouts) from coastal European wild cabbage; dogs from wolves; maize from teosinte in Mexico over millennia; Origin of Species 1859 ch. 1 "Variation under Domestication" with pigeons; brachycephalic breathing problems - all correct. Prereqs exist; stage concrete-operations = hard prereqs.

Gap real (biomimicry/bio-inspired nowhere else except one art-deco line). George de Mestral, Swiss engineer, 1941 burdock burrs on clothes and dog, microscope, hook-and-loop strips, Velcro brand (Wikipedia George_de_Mestral; history.com; velcro.com); 500-series Shinkansen nose modeled on kingfisher beak by birdwatcher engineer Eiji Nakatsu, quieter tunnel exits, ~15% less electricity (jrpass.com blog; multiple secondary sources); lotus-effect self-cleaning surfaces; burr seed dispersal - correct. All prereqs soft and exist.
